name: Iredell County, NC
findings: Iredell County has 499 nonprofit organizations. 195 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 146 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Iredell County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 15 education organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do education organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 48 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few professional organizations list public events
observations.text: No professional organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
